Title: LSJ - Joaquina Amaya and Jack of Both Sides

Messages.Author: Slytherin
Messages.Body:
Tried to find the answer but couldn't.

If Joaquina Amaya tried to use Jack of Both Sides to equip with a .44
Magnum, would she get her inbuilt +1 stealth on equip actions.

I would say yes, as The Summonng at superior is a recruit ally action,
but Charming Lobby isn't a political action (or at least isn't as far
as we can make out from the wordings).

Yes.

> I would say yes, as The Summonng at superior is a recruit ally action,
> but Charming Lobby isn't a political action (or at least isn't as far
> as we can make out from the wordings).

The Charming Lobby action is a political action (card text). The card is
not a political action card (cannot be burned for a vote, for example),
however.
